_help: What she says when you tell her to be quiet ({minutes} = how long she stays quiet) and when you say she can talk again.
Quiet_Ok: Okay. Quiet for {minutes} minutes. Shout if you need me.
Understood. I'll keep it down for {minutes} minutes.
Going quiet. Safety warnings only for {minutes} minutes.
Quiet_Polite: Of course. I'll be quiet for {minutes} minutes. Just say if you want me back.
Since you asked so nicely, quiet for {minutes} minutes.
Quiet_Rude: Wow. Okay. I'll shut up for {minutes} minutes. Safety warnings still count though.
Rude. But fine, {minutes} minutes of silence.
Quiet_Back: Back on, Commander. Did you miss me?
Talking again. I was getting rusty.
Good. I had so much to say.
